He previously played for the [[Brisbane Bullets]] of the [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL). He was drafted by the [[Chicago Bulls]] in the second round of the [[2025 NBA draft]]. ==Early life and career== Zikarsky was born in Hurstville (Sydney), New South Wales to German Olympic medal-winning swimmer [[Björn Zikarsky]]{{Cite web |title=Seven-foot-tall teen's big dreams to join NBA |url=https://9now.nine.com.au/a-current-affair/giant-aussie-teens-over-seven-foot-tall-still-growing-nba-dream/80ffcc6b-2337-48f4-9758-f6143074f87a |access-date=4 July 2024 |website=9now.nine.com.au |language=en-AU |archive-date=18 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240718214900/https://9now.nine.com.au/a-current-affair/giant-aussie-teens-over-seven-foot-tall-still-growing-nba-dream/80ffcc6b-2337-48f4-9758-f6143074f87a |url-status=live }} and Australian champion [[Ironman Triathlon|ironwoman]] Kylie Zikarsky.{{Cite news |date=2025-09-04 |title=Aussie sensation gears up for NBA preseason after 'stressful' draft |url=https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-09-05/aussie-basketballer-rocco-zikarsky-minnesota-timberwolves/105731074 |access-date=2025-09-04 |work=ABC News |language=en-AU}}{{cite news |date=16 September 2023 |title=Who is Rocco Zikarsky? ==Professional career== On 7 July 2023, Zikarsky signed with the [[Brisbane Bullets]] of the [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL) as part of the NBL's Next Stars program.{{cite news |title=Bullets Sign Giant Next Star |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/bullets-sign-giant-next-star |access-date=23 September 2024 |work=NBL.com.au |date=7 July 2023 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230707020119/https://nbl.com.au/news/bullets-sign-giant-next-star |archive-date=7 July 2023}} At 16 years old, he became the youngest player in the program's history.{{Cite web |title=Introducing The NBL's Next Stars: Rocco Zikarsky |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/introducing-the-nbls-next-stars-rocco-zikarsky |access-date=22 August 2024 |website=National in 10 and-a-half minutes against the [[Sydney Kings]].{{cite news |title=Bullets impress in snapping losing run to Kings |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/bullets-impress-in-snapping-losing-run-to-kings with the 45th overall pick by the [[Chicago Bulls]]. His draft rights were then immediately traded to the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]].{{cite news |title=Timberwolves Complete Draft Night Trade |url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/timberwolves-complete-draft-night-trade |access-date=28 June 2025 |work=timberwolves.com |date=6 July 2025 |quote=The Minnesota Timberwolves today announced the team has acquired the rights to center Rocco Zikarsky (Rock-oh Zih-KAR-skee), two future second round picks and cash considerations in a multi-team trade. |language=en |archive-date=6 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250706194457/https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/timberwolves-complete-draft-night-trade |url-status=live }}{{cite news |title=2025 NBA Draft: Pick 45 - Rocco Zikarsky |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/nba-draft-pick-45-rocco-zikarsky |access-date=27 June 2025 |work=nbl.com.au |date=27 June 2025 |language=en}} On July 9, 2025, he signed a [[two-way contract]] with the Timberwolves.{{Cite web|date=July 9, 2025|title=Timberwolves Sign Rocco Zikarsky to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/timberwolves-sign-rocco-zikarsky-to-two-way-contract|access-date=July 15, 2025|website=NBA.com|language=en|archive-date=24 July 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250724122338/https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/timberwolves-sign-rocco-zikarsky-to-two-way-contract|url-status=live}} In his pre-season debut against the [[Denver Nuggets]], he recorded 9 points, 8 rebounds and 1 steal in 13 minutes of play.{{Cite web |title=Aussies Abroad: Zikarsky shines in NBA pre-season debut |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/aussies-abroad-zikarsky-shines-in-nba-pre-season-debut |access-date=2025-10-06 |website=nbl.com.au |language=en}} On February 22, 2026, Zikarsky made his official NBA debut against the [[Philadelphia 76ers]], where he logged in one rebound in four minutes of gameplay in a 135-108 loss to the 76ers. ==National team career== In 2022, Zikarsky played for Australia at the [[2022 FIBA Under-16 Asian Championship|FIBA U16 Asian Championship]] and the [[2022 FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup|FIBA U17 Basketball World Cup]].{{cite web |title=Rocco Zikarsky - Player Profile |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/player/314338/Rocco-Zikarsky |website=FIBA.basketball |access-date=23 September 2024 |language=en}} In 2024, he led Australia to victory at the [[DBB Albert Schweitzer Tournament|Albert Schweitzer-Tournament]], earning MVP honours. He averaged 18.7 points, 11 rebounds, and 2.9 blocks in 26 minutes per game on 73.1% shooting.{{Cite web |last=G |first=Ayush |date=19 April 2024 |title=Could Rocco Zikarsky break out in NBL25 and
